book.implementation: WebGL 1, NEAREST atlas sampling, antialias=false, depth-tested full box surfaces, orthographic projection; no runtime dependency beyond React.
book.geometry: Seven-part reconstruction using dimensions, part transforms, page-opening equations and standard box UV layout observed in Mojang Java 1.21.5 client BookModel. The atlas is byte-identical to Bedrock, but this does not establish native Bedrock geometry, lighting or camera fidelity.
missingEvidence: Native enchanting_book_renderer mesh, projection, lighting, page-turn equations and camera transform
Same-size real-game screenshots for a fixed open/closed state

validation.browser: Chromium DPR=1 at isolated Vite port 5187
validation.observedImprovement: Default book visibly opens into two broad pages, with a central fold and page-block lower edges. Original five-plane slanted paper silhouette is removed. Orthographic, without native Bedrock camera or same-frame pixel comparison.
validation.acceptance: Renderer smoke and visual reconstruction review only; native Bedrock pixel acceptance remains outstanding.

controlledStateSmoke.method: Actual Chromium screenshots at DPR=1 on #c6c6c6, PNG pixel scan excluding background; this measures this implementation, not native Bedrock agreement.

primaryGeometryReference.edition: Java Edition 1.21.5, used only as a reconstruction reference
primaryGeometryReference.inspectionMethod: Read-only javap -c -p, with Mojang-provided official class mappings. Inspection artifacts stay in ignored .cache/enchanting-java-source; no client code or bytecode is bundled.
primaryGeometryReference.angle: 1.25 * clamp(open, 0, 1), radians; fixed time=0 for controlled rendering
primaryGeometryReference.guiPose: Scale [-40,40,40]/16 model units at GUI scale 1; X(180), Y(-90 - 90*(1-open)), translate (1-open)*[0.2,0.1,0.25] model units, X(25). Caller yaw/pitch/roll remain adjustable.
primaryGeometryReference.applicabilityLimit: These facts are observed in Java Edition and must not be described as extracted Bedrock renderer parameters.

atlas.reason: Original game font atlas; only caller-supplied atlasUrl or ignored local adapter is used.

runes.layout: A-Z/a-z atlas cells, advance measured as last opaque x + 2; whitespace advances 4 game pixels; integer scale, mask-repeat:none, no text shadow.

validation.method: Independent original-atlas pixel sampling and integer expansion vs Chromium CSS mask screenshot, using solid #c6c6c6 background and #685e4a foreground.

rights.texture: Original Mojang sample asset; retain upstream LICENSE.md and source attribution. Not relicensed as original MIT artwork.
rights.gameFont: Separately owned user-provided game font atlas, excluded from distributable package.

source.json: ui/enchanting_screen.json: enchant_cost, success_cost, fail_cost; ui/_global_variables.json: enchanting_cost_success_color, enchanting_cost_fail_color

confidence.foregroundAndAnchor: verified against installed Bedrock source JSON
confidence.shadowEnabled: verified against installed Bedrock source JSON
confidence.shadowColor: Color-derived 0.25 darkening approximation; exact Bedrock multiplier and quantization require a native-frame comparison.

validation.before: Both success and disabled text used the same fixed gray #3f3f3f shadow.
validation.after: Success shadow is dark green; failed shadow is dark red, with the original per-state foreground preserved.

visualSanityReference.state: Classic Bedrock, empty input, closed book
visualSanityReference.use: Closed brown cover silhouette only; different and unspecified game version, not a current native pixel oracle
